neighbours.label: Inner pieces of rare words: 'ogenous' of erogenous, 'olog' of heterologous, 'eros' of Westeros and hysterosalpingography, 'kov' of Cherenkov: a list, no shared pattern
fire: The mouth is an erogenous zone in many animals.
Some authors call the ear an erogenous area.
Surgeons used heterologous tissue in the graft.
Jon Snow left Westeros for the far north.
Cherenkov light glows blue in the reactor.
A hysteroscopy was done after the hysterosalpingography.
Readers love the maps of Westeros in the book.
quiet: The mouth is a sensitive area in many animals.
Some authors call the ear a useful area.
Surgeons used fresh tissue in the graft.
Jon Snow left Scotland for the far north.
Neon light glows red in the shop.
An X-ray was done after the blood test.
Readers love the maps of Narnia in the book.

notes: Card: 'og' x6, 'os' x3, 'rog' x3, 'ogenous' x2, 'olog' x2, 'eros' x2, 'kov' of Cherenkov. Probe: Cherenkov 'kov' 1.00, erogenous 0.95, heterologous 0.84, hysterosalpingography 'eros' 0.69, Westeros 0.49; plain alternatives 0.00. Tokenizer checked for the first three.
